metadata.title: Closing tar file in `TarFileReader` breaks buffered datapipes

trigger_conditions.condition: Creating a DataPipe pipeline where a buffered consumer such as Shuffler requests more elements than the upstream TarArchiveReader can provide, causing the underlying archive resource to be closed before all yielded streams are consumed.
trigger_conditions.operation_context: A datapipe pipeline uses TarArchiveReader followed by Shuffler, and Shuffler's buffer_size is greater than the number of entries in the tar archive, causing the archive to be exhausted and closed before yielded member streams are read.

failure_behavior.description: A datapipe pipeline uses TarArchiveReader followed by Shuffler, and Shuffler's buffer_size is greater than the number of entries in the tar archive, causing the archive to be exhausted and closed before yielded member streams are read.
